goal: Alert maintainers before Windows code signing certificates expire or are revoked
Prevents expedited or bugfix releases from being delayed by unexpected certificate issues
agreement: Support because certificates must work for point releases and automation avoids manual error (fanquake)
Approval without objections after revocation checking was added (achow101)
Objection on CRL size exceeding OpenSSL limits was fixed by downloading it separately (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it automates certificate monitoring rather than relying on release candidate cycles
Reduces the risk of unexpected release delays for urgent and bugfix releases
